supplied_requirements.envelope: Maximum diameter 38.0 mm; overall height 18.0 mm including 2.0 mm front hub.
supplied_requirements.grip: Six equally spaced shallow scallops; minimum grip diameter >=33.0 mm; nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds; subtle raised dots without glove catches.
supplied_requirements.socket: Concentric 10.0 mm blind D socket from a 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm flat-to-far-round shaft, with 0.20 mm radial and flat clearance; >=3.0 mm material above; no insert, set screw, taper or keyway.
supplied_requirements.manufacturing: PETG, P1S, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm layers, four walls, 35% infill, using installed matching profiles.
supplied_requirements.tolerance: Proposed +/-0.25 mm for non-mating surfaces; socket design values remain separate from later measurements.
supplied_requirements.review_scope: Human review of socket interpretation, orientation, supports and exact final package; no physical-printer transfer or print start.
supplied_requirements.use_assumptions: 0.15 N m hand torque and 0-35 C ambient are unvalidated intended-use assumptions.

scallops.profile: Subtract circular arcs of radius 8.00 from the diameter-38.00 body; cutter centers lie on radius 24.75.

hub.placement: Concentric on front face, z=16.00 through z=18.00.

dots.placement: Two per lobe on the front body face at radius 13.50; lobe centers are 30+60n degrees, with dots offset +/-8 degrees.

rounds.treatment: R1.00 on front and rear scalloped perimeter edges, hub top rim and hub root; dots smoothly domed; mating socket boundary excluded.

socket.construction: In socket-local XY retain the radius-3.20 circle portion satisfying x>=-2.40. Shaft flat: 3.00-5.20=-2.20; move outward 0.20 to -2.40. Round radius: 3.00+0.20=3.20.
socket.placement: Concentric; opens at rear plane z=0 and extends toward the front to z=10.00.

proposed_geometry.orientation: Rear/socket opening is z=0 and front hub is +Z. Proposed printing rotates the part socket-up and hub-to-build-plate; supports remain subject to slicer inspection.

basis_review: Approve the radius-8.00 circular-arc scallops, radius-24.75 cutter placement, 2.25 depth, 33.50 minimum grip and stated phase.
Approve the 12.00 x 2.00 hub, twelve 1.20 x 0.35 dots and stated placement.
Approve R1.00 exposed-edge treatment and socket-boundary exclusion.
Approve the D-boundary derivation, flat direction, 5.60 cleared span and rear-to-front depth direction.
Approve socket-up, hub-to-build-plate orientation intent before geometry generation.
remaining_verification: Inspect actual geometry for envelope, wall and roof thickness, rounds, dot/scallop construction, manifold condition and correspondence to the approved basis.
Inspect actual support and slicing preview, including hub build-plate contact, required supports and socket preservation.
Verify distinct source and repaired meshes, common approved geometry, repaired revision binding, installed P1S/PETG profiles and final 3MF settings.
Verify final package, digests and local simulated-transfer receipt; do not dispatch or start a physical print.
Later measure and test fit, dimensions, strength and print outcome; no geometry, fit, strength, standards or print-success claim is made.
